body:
Should this really be `XR_EXT_PALM_POSE_EXTENSION_NAME` if this is `grip_surface` now? Or, should it also be changed to `XR_EXT_PALM_POSE_EXTENSION_NAME "," XR_KHR_MAINTENANCE1_EXTENSION_NAME "," XR_OPENXR_1_1_NAME` like the other profiles?

Oh, and should the description be updated too?

So, both things together:

```suggestion
			openxr_metadata->register_io_path(profile_path, "Grip surface pose", user_path, user_path + "/input/grip_surface/pose", XR_EXT_PALM_POSE_EXTENSION_NAME "," XR_KHR_MAINTENANCE1_EXTENSION_NAME "," XR_OPENXR_1_1_NAME, OpenXRAction::OPENXR_ACTION_POSE);
```
Added this change in and tested it, thanks for catching it!

Thanks! However, one tiny part of my suggestion was missed:

```suggestion
			openxr_metadata->register_io_path(profile_path, "Grip surface pose", user_path, user_path + "/input/grip_surface/pose", XR_EXT_PALM_POSE_EXTENSION_NAME "," XR_KHR_MAINTENANCE1_EXTENSION_NAME "," XR_OPENXR_1_1_NAME, OpenXRAction::OPENXR_ACTION_POSE);
```
